text:
acme_integration: Hi team, after yesterday's model rollout our integration is failing — the model used to call our external function `get_price(product_id)` but now it's either not invoking the function at all or invoking it with the wrong arguments. This started immediately after the 23:45 UTC deploy. We'll escalate if needed, but need a quick workaround, customers are seeing incorrect prices.

Laura (Support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste one example request + the model response you received? Also which model/version and the rollout id if you have it?

acme_integration: Example (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-2.1-opt",
  "input": "Get price for product 42, currency USD",
  "tools": ["get_price"]
}
```
Response body we got (truncated):
```
{"choices":[{"text":"Price: call get_price(\"42\", \"EUR\")"}]}
```
So it returned a call but arguments are wrong (EUR vs USD) and sometimes it returns no call and just writes text. Previously it always emitted a structured function invocation: `{"tool":"get_price","args":{"product_id":"42","currency":"USD"}}`.

Ethan (SRE): @acme_integration thanks — can you share the request_id from headers (x-rw-request) and approx time for the failing calls? Also is this happening for all customers or only you?

acme_integration: Request id `req_0a1b2c3d`, failures logged 2026-02-16T23:46:12Z and 23:47:05Z, only seen in our production after you flipped the canary to 100% last night. QA on the previous version was fine.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-02-16T23:45:00Z: rollout redwood-2.1-opt -> variants [redwood-2.1-opt-quant, redwood-2.1-opt-fp16] completed to prod (canary: 100%).

Rohan (ML Eng): Copying the sample — two quick hypotheses: 1) tool-call schema drift — the newer runtime variant might be sending a looser serialization for function calls and the signature mapping code is mis-parsing currency as language text; 2) a model-behavior/regression where the policy that emits structured calls started emitting plain text or different arg orders after tokenization change.

Jess (Product): We need triage steps and an immediate mitigation. Customers reporting incorrect prices is high-severity. Laura, can you confirm if this is causing billing impact?

Laura (Support): Logged as sev-2 for now. acme_integration says customers saw wrong displayed prices (not billing yet), but risk is high. I recommended switching them to our previous model version as a mitigation.

Ethan (SRE): Rohan, can you check runtime logs around req_0a1b2c3d for any kernel selection or variant fallbacks? Might be an incompatible quantized kernel chosen for short sequences.

Rohan (ML Eng): On it. Also please have them try forcing `model_variant=redwood-2.1-opt-fp16` or pin to `redwood-2.0-stable` via API header to confirm rollback fixes it. That will tell us if it's model-level or routing/runtime.

acme_integration: Quick test: pinned to `redwood-2.0-stable` and the function call returned correctly in our next request. So rollback seems to avoid the issue.

Rohan (ML Eng): That's a helpful repro. Means regression introduced in 2.1 variants or runtime kernels. Ethan, do we have a diff of compile flags used for 2.1-opt-quant?

Ethan (SRE): Collecting. Meanwhile I'll add a temporary routing rule for accounts that set `strict_fn_invocation=true` to force canonical function-call JSON and reject ambiguous textual emissions. If customer sets that flag they should see strict structured calls.

Laura (Support): Sharing workaround to acme_integration: set header `X-Redwood-Strict-Function-Calls: 1` or pin to `redwood-2.0-stable`. Would you like us to apply a tenant-level pin while we investigate?

acme_integration: Yes please pin us back to `redwood-2.0-stable` for now. Also we captured a failing transcript in our logs — sending pasted excerpt: 
```
User prompt: "Get price for SKU 42 in USD"
Model output (raw): "Price seems to be 19.99. call get_price(42, EUR)"
HTTP response sent to client: {
  "text": "Price seems to be 19.99. call get_price(42, EUR)"
}
```
The client expects function-calls so this is breaking parsing on our side (we only act on structured JSON).

Rohan (ML Eng): Thanks — that shows mixed-mode emission. Could be an internal sampling temperature change or an altered instruction that lets model output freeform text plus a function-like snippet. I'll run evals against our function-call test harness comparing 2.0 vs 2.1 variants.

deploy-bot: Alert: rollback window opens. Deployment 2026-02-16T23:50:00Z scheduled canary rollback if critical.

Ethan (SRE): Action items: 1) Pin acme_integration to 2.0 (Laura to do), 2) Collect kernel/quantization flags for 2.1 variants (Ethan), 3) ML to run deterministic function-call eval suite and attach failing seed+prompt (Rohan).

Laura (Support): Pin applied to tenant acme_integration -> redwood-2.0-stable. Confirm they saw correct outputs after pin?

acme_integration: Confirmed — after pin we saw structured `{"tool":"get_price","args":{"product_id":"42","currency":"USD"}}`. Thanks.

Rohan (ML Eng): Preliminary findings from local eval: redwood-2.1-opt-quant sometimes emits function calls as inline text when the model's stop token config and decoding strategy are changed for quant variant. Also a small mismatch in the function-call serialization layer: some quant kernels return tokens with leading whitespace that our parser mis-handles, producing string arguments like " EUR". We'll prepare a patch to sanitize token boundaries before parsing.

Ethan (SRE): We should treat this as a stopgap: parser lenient fix + rollback to stable until we patch and run full regression suite. Rohan, can you estimate timeframe?

Rohan (ML Eng): Patch for parser sanitization in runtime: ~6 hours for dev + CI. Longer if quant kernel changes need retrain. Will post PR link when ready.

Jess (Product): Also add test cases for currency recognition and strict function-call mode to our regression matrix. This has product impact for many customers.

Laura (Support): Case tracker: SUP-2026-0421. Escalating to eng-runtime and eng-ml, assigned Rohan (ML Eng) and Ethan (SRE). I'll update acme_integration and let them know ETA for permanent fix.

acme_integration: Appreciate the fast turnaround and the temporary pin. Please keep us posted and let us know if you need any more logs.

Rohan (ML Eng): Will follow up here. If anyone else sees similar reports, drop them into this thread.

Laura (Support): Closing loop for now — mitigation applied, escalation filed, eng triage active. (:white_check_mark:)

[thread closed but will be updated with PR link and postmortem]
